meta.designPrinciple: Editorial confidence, not decoration for its own sake. Typography and whitespace carry the expression, so every additional color or flourish has to earn a specific job — and loses that job the moment two of them compete for it.
meta.removedElement: First draft set a decorative drop-cap treatment on the agent's opening message AND a full-bleed ochre header band AND an animated accent rule under the header name — three expressive moves stacked on one screen region. Kept the header band, cut the drop-cap and the animated rule; the band alone already signals 'this is an edited, considered voice.'

generatedFrom.referenceDescription: Extracted from an editorial-press reference: confident serif display type with real optical contrast, generous top/bottom margins on short text blocks, a restrained 2-3 color story where one deep hue does most of the work and a second only ever appears in small accents.

reducedMotion.strategy: collapse the 260ms editorial fade/rise entrances to an instant 1-frame appearance

iconography.styleDescriptor: 1.75px stroke, mostly straight with a single deliberate curved accent per icon, no fill

thinking.description: Ellipsis in display italic, soft fade cycle.

error.description: Mark desaturates, small danger rule beneath.

approvalBanner.entryMotion: single 260ms rise, editorial-standard easing, no loop

iconSet.name: Tabler Icons
iconSet.note: Fallback set for glyphs an editorial mark-language needs but a strict outline set doesn't have.

fontSource.name: Google Fonts
fontSource.note: Fraunces (variable, optical-size axis) + Karla, both self-hostable.

illustrationSource.name: Pexels
illustrationSource.note: Photographic, not illustrated -- matches the editorial-press reference better than flat illustration would. Not OSI; check redistribution terms before bundling.

chartLibrary.name: visx
chartLibrary.note: Low-level enough to match Fraunces/Karla typography inside a chart rather than a generic chart-library default look.

react.name: assistant-ui
react.note: Copy-in chat primitives leave room to swap the default sans for Karla without fighting a packaged theme; built on the same shadcn/ui foundation as the plainer HTML adapter.

contrastReport.pairing: primitive.secondary.600 #A66E1F on background.surface #FFFDF8 -- REJECTED as text

Not a live bug -- secondary.600 is never used as text in preview.html, only secondary.500 appears, and only as a decorative non-text rule/swatch fill. Documented fill/icon-only.

Clears the 3:1 non-text/icon floor comfortably; body copy inside the banner stays in text.primary at 17.97:1, never in the approval color itself.

a11y.readingOrder: DOM order matches visual order; the header band's decorative rule is aria-hidden.
